titulo_es: A simple order · Food and menus

texto: In a menu, the name of the dish is usually followed by the ingredients or the price. To order with courtesy you can use «Jeg vil gerne have …, tak»; tak works in this formula, but it is not a universal translation of «Please.».
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
